interface.shortDescription: Controlled remote access to your computers.
interface.longDescription: Remote Arc connects AI clients to Windows, macOS, and Linux computers you explicitly pair. Inspect files, run approved development commands, use explicitly shared browser tabs, and manage deterministic durable tasks under per-device permissions and local safety boundaries. Continuous autonomous AI reasoning after a chat ends is not currently a production capability.
interface.defaultPrompt: List my Remote Arc devices, then tell me what is online and which remote tools are available.

name: remote-arc
description: Controlled remote computer access for AI across computers you authorize.
